frame: Google Earth's georeference of the 17 Oct 2023 aerial, in model metres (x east, z south) about tools/grounds/ge/grounds.json's Ikon Park origin.
source: Google Earth web historical imagery: aerial of 17 Oct 2023, straight-down capture at 0.132 m a pixel; painted line traced along 1440 rays; goals by 50 m arc then goal square.

error_m.dates_agree: goals: Dec 2021, Mar 2022, Dec 2022 and Oct 2023 agree to 0.05 m in length (156.9 m) and 0.05 deg. Line: Dec 2021 and Mar 2022 sit a median 1.18 m further out from the goals' midpoint than Oct 2023 (p90 2.1 m), Dec 2022 2.4 m: the line was repainted during the 2022 redevelopment, so dates are not merged.
error_m.placement: not checked against a model: main's Ikon Park model and the Legacy era (1990-2005) differ from today's ground.

notes: Held in pending/: today's (2023) line, measured. Legacy plays Ikon Park in its 1990-2005 layout, whose boundary today's imagery can't show; use only if a model of today's ground is wanted.
fence_how: where the grass stops (for 1.5 m) going outward from the line in the same 2023 aerial; points more than 1 m off a robust smooth fit are fence_seen false.
